title: Muddles
description: An early version of a mod consisting of my mcreator experiments
body:
A currently small mod adding 4 new biomes with their own woodsets, ants which fight each other based on their color (Currently only workers and soldiers), 5 new flowers to spice up your gardens and more to come. The mod purpose is to make the blocky world of minecraft more lively so if anyone's bored of the barren biomes of the overworld this is the mod for you!         

<details>
<summary>Future Plans</summary>

For the future i plan to add:
- Nether & End biomes                                                                                                       
- Expand on the ants, and add new ones like the queen ant                                           - Add a new ore in-between iron and diamond for a smoother transition                                          - Expand on existing structure & biomes (Like the jungle temple!)                                               - And more                                                                                                                                                                                     </details>



NOTE: This mod uses NeoForge 1.21.4
